blocks.orig: Tanzanite is one of the world’s rarest gemstones, mined only in Tanzania. If you have an interest in shiny gemstones, then a visit to the Tanzanite Museum Arusha is for you. During a visit, you can see and touch this beautiful violet-blue gemstone, and learn all about how the stone is discovered, hewed, and processed in an imitation mine shaft. You can even buy your very own specimen to bring home!
blocks.html: Tanzanite, found only in Tanzania, ranks among the rarest gemstones in the world. Do sparkling gemstones fascinate you? Then the Tanzanite Museum Arusha is worth a visit. Here you can see and hold this lovely violet-blue stone, and discover in a replica mine shaft how it is found, cut and processed. You can even buy a stone of your own to take home!
